info.title: Portfolio API
info.description:
Content API for the portfolio site.

- `/api/public/*` — read-only, published content. Authenticate with an API token in `X-API-Key` (or `Authorization: Bearer`).
- `/api/admin/*` — content management. Authenticate by signing in through `/api/auth/login` (httpOnly cookies) and send `X-CSRF-Token` from `/api/auth/csrf-token` on every non-GET request.
